commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using introduction to python.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for introduction to python?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on introduction to python?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with introduction to python?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using data types.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for data types?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on data types?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with data types?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using operators.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using comparison operators.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for comparison operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on comparison operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with comparison operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using assignment operators.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for assignment operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on assignment operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with assignment operators?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for identity operators?

interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for lists?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on lists?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with lists?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using tuples.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for tuples?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on tuples?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with tuples?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using conditional statements.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for conditional statements?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on conditional statements?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with conditional statements?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using for loops.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for for loops?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on for loops?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with for loops?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using pattern programming.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for pattern programming?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on pattern programming?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with pattern programming?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for lambda?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on lambda?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with lambda?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using list comprehension.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for list comprehension?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on list comprehension?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with list comprehension?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using exception handling.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for exception handling?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on exception handling?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with exception handling?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using classes and objects.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for classes and objects?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on classes and objects?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with classes and objects?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using inheritance.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for inheritance?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on inheritance?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with inheritance?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).

commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for generators?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on generators?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with generators?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.

commonMistakes.mistake: Ignoring zero-based indexing or mutable default arguments when using regular expressions.
commonMistakes.correction: Always use immutable defaults (like None) and verify loop bounds.
commonMistakes.why: Python stores mutable defaults across successive function calls.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing identity (is) with equality (==).
commonMistakes.correction: Use '==' to check value equality and 'is' to check memory reference.
commonMistakes.why: Small integer caching can lead to deceptive behavior if 'is' is misused.

interviewQuestions.q: How does Python handle memory management for regular expressions?
interviewQuestions.a: Python uses private heap memory, reference counting, and a cyclic garbage collector to automatically manage allocations.

interviewQuestions.q: What is the time complexity of typical operations on regular expressions?
interviewQuestions.a: Most standard operations run in O(1) or O(N) amortized time, optimized through Python's C-level implementation.

interviewQuestions.q: What are common interview gotchas associated with regular expressions?
interviewQuestions.a: Watch for shallow vs deep copy differences, variable scoping (LEGB rule), and unexpected type conversions.
